title: How to have your background moving in RPG MAKER XP

posts.author: RyanJimenez
posts.body:
Hello, so I am developing a game right now and I need some advice on how to move your background because when I walk, the screen is not moving.
I want it to be like the big RPG Maker horror titles where the background is moving or scrolling.
If you use RPG Maker XP, you are a big help and thanks for your advice.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
Make the map bigger?
I'm not sure what you mean by the "background is scrolling". You'd need to explain better.

posts.author: RyanJimenez
posts.body:
